instruction: What is the optimal planting date for maize in Kano State, and what are the recommended seed rates and plant populations for different maize varieties?
response: For Kano State, which falls within the Sudan/Sahel Savanna zone, the optimal planting date for maize is between 1 and 30 April. This is based on the recommendation to plant as soon as the rainfall becomes steady, which aligns with the general guidelines provided for the Derived Savannah zone. For seed rates and plant populations, the recommended amounts are as follows: (i) 25 kg/ha for open pollinated varieties, (ii) 15 kg/ha for hybrids, and (iii) 15 kg for popcorn. For planting geometry, hand planting is recommended for open-pollinated and popcorn varieties at a spacing of 90 cm x 40 cm, resulting in 55,555 plants/ha. For hybrids, the same spacing is also recommended, giving 55,555 plants/ha. For mechanical planting, the recommended spacing is 75 cm x 25 cm or 90 cm x 20 cm, with 1 plant/stand giving 53,555 or 55,555 plants/ha, respectively. Always use certified seeds of recommended varieties for good crop establishment.

instruction: Based on the information provided, what is the recommended fertilizer application for maize in the Northern Guinea Savanna zone of Bauchi State, Nigeria?
response: For maize in the Northern Guinea Savanna zone of Bauchi State, Nigeria, the recommended fertilizer application is as follows: In the early season, apply 400 kg (8 bags) of 25:10:10, 100 kg (2 bags) of Single Super-phosphate and 3 to 5 kg of Zinc Sulphate per/ha at planting as band or broadcast application, to give 100 kg N, 58 kg P2O5; 40 kg K2O, 14 kg S and 1 to 2 kg Zn per/ha. Alternatively, apply 500 kg (10 bags) of 20-10-10-2S-1Zn per/ha at planting. In the late season, the fertilizer rate and time of application are the same as for the early season. It is ideal to carry out soil testing before any fertilizer application and if the above fertilizer recommendation has been used repeatedly on the same field for more than four years, it is advisable to submit soil samples for testing before further application. This service is available at I.A.R.&T., Moor Plantation, Ibadan.

instruction: How to safely transport different sizes of catfish and tilapia during open transportation for less than 5 hours?
response: When transporting catfish and tilapia for less than 5 hours, use the following guidelines based on the provided information. For catfish fingerlings, fill the containers with approximately 50 jerican of water and transport no more than 750 fish. For adult catfish, use 1 jerican of water and transport 150-200 fish. For tilapia fingerlings, use 1 bucket of water and transport 200-230 fish. For adult tilapia, use 1 bucket of water and transport 100-150 fish.
